UserVault.title: UserVault
UserVault.description: Metadata and statistics for a user's 40,000+ WhatsApp Business contact vault.

ownerId.description: UID of the authenticated vault owner.

totalContacts.description: Total number of contacts stored across all chunks.

activeStatusCount.description: Number of contacts assigned to the Active Status Tier (kept in phone for WhatsApp Status).

archiveLeadCount.description: Number of contacts assigned to the Cloud Archive Tier (messaged directly via deep-link).

chunkCount.description: Number of contact chunk documents currently stored.

defaultCountryCode.description: Default international dialing prefix used when normalizing local numbers.

linkedSheetId.description: Optional Google Spreadsheet ID linked for administrative management.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the vault was initialized.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the vault metadata was last updated.

ContactChunk.title: ContactChunk
ContactChunk.description: A compressed batch document holding up to 500 contacts to enable syncing 40,000+ contacts in ~80 Firestore reads/writes.

ownerId.description: UID of the authenticated vault owner.

contactCount.description: Count of contacts inside this chunk (0 to 500).

contacts.description: Bounded list of up to 500 contact records (id, name, phone, tier, group).

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the chunk was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the chunk was last updated.

MessageTemplate.title: MessageTemplate
MessageTemplate.description: Reusable WhatsApp Business quick-forward message template.

ownerId.description: UID of the authenticated template owner.

usageCount.description: Number of times this template was used for direct forwarding.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the template was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the template was last updated.

VaultNotification.title: VaultNotification
VaultNotification.description: Real-time notification synced via Firestore to trigger mobile/web system tray alerts and in-app notification center.

ownerId.description: UID of the target user receiving the notification.

title.description: Notification headline displayed in system tray and in-app feed.

read.description: Whether the user has marked the notification as read.

source.description: Source of the notification (firestore_realtime, google_sheets, system).

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the notification was dispatched.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the notification was last updated.

/users/{userId}.description: Root vault metadata document for each authenticated user.

/users/{userId}/contactChunks/{chunkId}.description: Chunked contact storage documents under the user's vault.

/users/{userId}/templates/{templateId}.description: Quick-forward WhatsApp message templates owned by the user.

/users/{userId}/notifications/{notificat.description: Real-time notifications stream for mobile/web tray and in-app notification center.
